band_policy.interval_convention: lower inclusive, upper exclusive; T_24H_PLUS has no upper bound

policy.change_awareness_current_rule: latest legal prematch version by freeze_created_at, prediction_created_at, prediction_id
policy.change_awareness_previous_rule: immediately preceding legal prematch version by the same chronology
policy.horizon_percentile_rule: linear interpolation over sorted safe unique-match minutes
policy.horizon_timestamp_rule: kickoff_at - freeze_created_at; both timezone-aware; freeze strictly before kickoff

sample_funnel.observation_unit: one football match = one unique match_key; version rows are audit history only

scope.observation_unit: one football match = one unique match_key
